All critical algebra identities and samples reproduced by embedded verify.py; continuum exclusion is proved analytically, not by enumeration.

value.rationale: Modes 3 and 5 are the first nontranslation odd harmonics for constant-width ovals and the first support family capable of a cusp-count transition. The result is a complete structural classification of two related singular curves (both generic intervals and all degenerate walls) and exposes a strict two-cusp gap while giving a single exact counterpair with equal width, perimeter, area, and two oriented caustic areas but inequivalent cusp structure. This is a motivated topology-versus-integral-geometry distinction, not a trivial renamed inequality or arbitrary finite number.
